rationale: Plan addresses the high-cost prediction task by: (1) using paid_amount at p90 (top 10%) threshold computed on training data only to prevent leakage; (2) selecting 15 features available at claim submission (claim type, place of service, provider specialty, utilization and clinical indicators, billed/allowed amounts) while excluding paid_amount, member_oop, cob_amount, identifiers, and target-derived fields; (3) fitting preprocessing on training data only; (4) training logistic regression and gradient boosting as required; (5) including synthetic_data caveat per retrieved skill evolved_run_006_001; (6) showing denominators and artifact citations for transparency and reproducibility across the standard artifacts (model_metrics, threshold, feature_list, precision_at_k, report, metrics).
